chapter: Arriving in New York: the Nest Club and Harlem nightlife
title: Johnny Dunn, I am the King
summary: At the Amsterdam Club Danny saw Pike Davis and Johnny Dunn, who announced himself the King, and notes musicians had to be their own press agents.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah. He was Juice Aikens or something. Well, you'd see all these people. You'd see legends around. Now, at the Amsterdam Club, you'd see all them guys that worked the theatre. Pike Davis...
Yeah. And I was fortunate enough to see Johnny Dunn just before he went to Europe.
Yeah. Saw him. He was a tall man. Didn't have much to say, only that he was... He would make this great announcement: "I am the King." He was the King trumpet player....
Well, you had to sell yourself in those days. Everybody did. Bill Robinson. Jelly Roll.
Well, that was it. They didn't have no press agents. You had to be your own press agent. That's what people don't understand about Night People. They'll accept with that Night People.
